newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco C.bank injects 175 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco C.bank injects 175 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 175 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Monday.

The bank received bids totalling 5.561 billion dirhams and allocated 3.750 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 3.575 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 67.43 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on May 14, 1997.
